title: Will AI Change Human Evolution?
fullTitle: Soul Feast #64: Will AI Change Human Evolution?

promo.text: Discover how intentional choices can transform your life. Download this meditation on Responsible Choice today .

description: Humanity stands in a rare moment of profound transformation, and in this Soul Feast, Gary explores a question many are asking:
Will artificial intelligence alter human evolution?

Instead of approaching the topic from an intellectual or technological angle, Gary guides listeners toward the deeper truth – evolution has never been driven by tools, inventions, or external advancements. True human evolution unfolds within consciousness, and the shift now underway is not about smarter machines but about humanity becoming multisensory , aware of itself as more than a physical body and a thinking mind.

As Gary explains, AI – like gunpowder, agriculture, railroads, television, or the internet – can change what we experience , but not who we are . The real transformation comes from recognizing ourselves as souls learning in the Earth School, perceiving the difference between love and fear within our own personalities, and choosing love before we speak or act. This inner capability, now emerging across billions of people, marks the beginning of a new human evolution that no machine can replicate or direct.

Ultimately, this Soul Feast reveals that AI will not change human evolution because human evolution requires the heart. Only emotional awareness, authentic power, and multisensory perception can alter the trajectory of our species. Technology cannot evolve us – but each individual can, through conscious choice.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(00:30) — Why advances like gunpowder, railroads, telegraphs, television, and the internet changed human experience but not human evolution (02:05) — How five-sensory perception shaped human history – and why the shift to multisensory awareness is unprecedented (04:43) — Why tools, including AI, can magnify external power but cannot transform consciousness (06:10) — What the soul values (harmony, cooperation, sharing, reverence for life) and why technological speed or conquest cannot fulfill it (08:51) — What might happen when humanity gains the ability to travel to Mars with intentions rooted in fear vs. intentions rooted in love (12:37) — How new consciousness enables humans to experience non-physical reality and see life through the lens of the soul (16:31) — How choosing love over fear creates authentic power and is the real force that evolves humanity (20:00) — A practical Soul Step for tracking frightened and loving parts of your personality throughout the week

Take out your notebook and, throughout the coming week, write down every moment you notice a frightened part of your personality – anger, judgment, resentment, withdrawal, superiority, or the need to please. Note what triggered it and how it felt in your body. Then record each moment when you chose not to act from that fear, and instead experimented with appreciation, understanding, or compassion for the other person involved.

At the end of the week, read what you’ve written and ask: What can I learn about myself from this? Let this practice show you where evolution is unfolding inside you – and how your choices shape the world you help create.
